# The editor pre-wrap workaround was withdrawn rather than becoming whitespace policy

Entry2177 adds body white-space:pre-wrap as a workaround for upstream normalization changes. The complete assigned review later records a warning that previously invisible tabs may become visible, an explicit backout and abandonment with not relanding. Available Bug 1955047 also requests not shipping the workaround in beta. The full fixed editorContent.css was inspected: it has no white-space declaration, although a separate dark-mode body color rule remains. Thus neither initial acceptance nor the tracker fixed label establishes this workaround as current practice. The review suggestion to normalize expected NBSP is conditional on a test accepting any whitespace sequence; it is not a rule to weaken exact-whitespace assertions and was not implemented in this one-file patch. Missing Bug comment5 prevents a complete audit; the reverting diff and Gecko normalization implementation were not separately audited. No editor rendering or test ran.

Scope: Compose whitespace workaround outcome.
